surface_verification.justification: monorepo tooling change (a new CLI producer script + a prompt-wiring edit to an interview reference doc); no startable web/dev-server/CLI surface of its own to browser-verify -- verification is the unit test suite itself (F0) plus the CLI-shaped tests exercising the wired invocation.

behaviors.behavior: AC1: write_context_term.py creates CONTEXT.md following context-format.md's schema (header, Language/Relationships/Flagged ambiguities sections) when none exists
AC1: an unchanged term set re-runs byte-identical (idempotent), including a single term and a two-term document
AC1: re-sharpening the same term overwrites in place (last write wins), never producing a second entry
AC1: an update preserves every hand-written Relationships/Flagged-ambiguities section and hand-written Language prose byte-for-byte, including the file's own CRLF/LF convention
AC2: interview-protocol.md invokes write_context_term.py with the required flags, in the same turn a term is sharpened (not deferred to end-of-interview)
AC3: a term elicited/sharpened through the wired CLI invocation shape lands in CONTEXT.md in the documented format
AC4: a second sharpened term (via the wired CLI path) does not corrupt or duplicate the first
an embedded newline in --term/--definition/--avoid is collapsed to single-line prose so it cannot mis-parse as a second entry on the next run
a blank --term/--definition, or a --term containing ** (the entry delimiter), is rejected rather than corrupting the next parse
